title: TechScript
tagline: A modern programming language and developer ecosystem built from the ground up in Rust.
description: TechScript is a complete programming language ecosystem featuring a custom Lexer, Parser, AST architecture, Stack-based Bytecode VM, Standard library, and Package manager — all engineered in Rust for maximum performance.

title: NovOS
tagline: A futuristic web-based desktop operating system with neomorphic window management.
description: NovOS is a full web-based operating system providing a reactive desktop interface, custom window manager, virtual file system, taskbar app launcher, and built-in system app ecosystem in React & TypeScript.

title: Aurora-OS.js
tagline: Extensible web OS game and hacking simulator framework in TypeScript.
description: Aurora OS.js is an extensible web OS game and hacking simulator framework. Provides a virtual OS experience with scripting, sandboxed apps, interactive terminals, and gameplay mechanics.

title: OS Wallpapers
tagline: Collection of minimalist wallpapers tailored for operating system interfaces.
description: A hand-crafted collection of ambient wallpapers and background textures designed specifically for custom Linux setups, Android ROMs, and desktop operating systems.

title: ARC Reactor 3D
tagline: Interactive 3D Iron Man ARC Reactor rendering engine in Three.js & TypeScript.
description: An interactive 3D WebGL experience rendering a high-detail Iron Man ARC Reactor with customizable energy core glow, rotating metallic rings, and dynamic lighting effects.

title: Vortyx
tagline: High-performance CLI utility and system performance tool.
description: Vortyx is a lightweight system performance utility designed for monitoring system resources, process trees, and runtime metrics with zero overhead.

title: NeoSketch
tagline: Offline AI-powered artistic photo editor for Android & Windows.
description: NeoSketch is an offline AI-powered artistic photo editor for Android and Windows built with Flutter, Rust, and ONNX runtime for privacy-first image processing.
